basic_info.description: Absolutely gorgeous 3 level 4BR/3BA home has a great open floorplan with a spacious living room with filtered views, a comfortable separate dining area and the adjacent kitchen with stainless steel appliances. Hardwood floors accentuate the living space ideal for gatherings and socializing. There is a full bath on this main level. The level below features  a completely separate suite with access to a huge deck. On the 3rd floor there are 3 good-sized bedrooms, one a master suite. The lush exquisite garden is accessed on this level. There is a 2 car side-by-side garage and ample storage throughout. A special treat are solar panels. Move right in and live a life you love. 2020-10-19
